metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-63. - Obstruction due to construction.
content.summary:
All construction which blocks curbs, gutters or sidewalks on public rights-of-way
               is expressly prohibited.
(Code 1981, § 30-48; Ord. No. 1432, § 14, 3-6-1978)
